title: opennextjs-azure configuration
description: Settings for deploying a Next.js app to Azure with opennextjs-azure.

appName.description: Application name, used as the prefix for all Azure resources.

resourceGroup.description: Azure resource group to deploy into. Created if it doesn't exist.

location.description: Azure region, e.g. eastus or westeurope.

environment.description: Deployment environment. dev and staging use the Consumption plan; prod uses Elastic Premium.

applicationInsights.description: Provision Application Insights for logs and monitoring.
